pr_comments: Hey there @bendavid, mind taking a look at this pull request as its been labeled with a integration (`webostv`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L435) for? Thanks!

So this might work, but I'm not sure if it's the right approach.  The original logic was that the client does not need to be able to successfully connect in order to register the entity, as long as the tv was previously paired.

The only reason this broke is because of the introduction of unique_id requiring information which is only available when the TV is on.

An alternative would be to remove unique_id for now and address this by adding the relevant information to the file which stores the pairing information which is written by the client library, such that it is always available once the TV is paired.
If an entity is not added, Home Assistant will automatically create the entity as unavailable so it can still sync to Google etc. This should work as expected.

Can confirm, this works. Started HA with tv off, retry logic triggers. Start tv, connects and sets up the platform as normal.

Cheers @ludeeus :beers:

It can be nice to use a back off mechanism like this:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/15569f1e7fc2fa79de88f8c933973e1bd818f517/homeassistant/components/tibber/__init__.py#L51
